caveats.note: A letter the view once failed to find can keep drawing as a box after a font that has it is imported, until a full restart: რ stayed a box with the Thai build as its only claimant.

evidence.observed: Venu 2, 19.05, with Garmin's original fonts imported (the 21 ExtData fonts it declares): Georgian in notifications drew as boxes; English and Armenian rendered.

Venu 2, 19.05: with Georgian builds of all four Armenian sizes, each marking Հ differently, the Gmail pop-up drew the 27 px build's marker (Գ, 006-D9035-03) and its Georgian; the 21, 24 and 31 px markers didn't appear. Georgian has rendered from the Armenian builds since (the registry's tested entry).

Venu 2, 19.05: with Garmin's original Armenian fonts restored and Georgian added to the four Thai sizes (006-D8947-20..23), each drawing ჰ as a different Mkhedruli letter and ก as ข, a Gmail notification drew both ქართული and ᲥᲐᲠᲗᲣᲚᲘ as Georgian, ჰჰ as გგ (the 27 px build, 006-D8947-22) and กข as one Thai glyph twice.

Venu 2, 19.05: with Garmin's original Armenian and Thai fonts and Georgian added to the four Korean sizes (006-D8945-20..23), each drawing ჰ as a different Mkhedruli letter and 가 as 나, a Gmail notification drew both ქართული and ᲥᲐᲠᲗᲣᲚᲘ as Georgian, ჰჰ as ზზ (the 27 px build, 006-D8945-22) and 가나 as one Korean glyph twice; the 21, 24 and 31 px markers didn't appear.

Venu 2, 19.05: with Garmin's original Armenian and Thai fonts, a Compressed (per-glyph RLE) Georgian build of 006-D8945-22 from the builder's encoder, every other Korean part Garmin's, drew both Georgian cases and its own markers.

Venu 2, 19.05: the Thai 27 px font with მ mapped to ง's tile, next to the Armenian 27 px build that has მ: Gmail 708319 drew მ as ง and the Thai marker, so the Thai font comes first for a letter both have.

Venu 2, 19.05: with რ removed from the Armenian 27 px build and mapped only in the Thai routing build, Gmail 708322 still drew რ as a box while both builds' markers showed; before a full restart, the seven distinct letters of the first failed word ქართული drew as boxes and every other letter rendered.

sources.section: Single modified claimant for რ (708322); Coverage before a full restart
